read.title: Your Visit to Our Factory
read.text:
Dear Mr. Rossi,

We look forward to welcoming you to our facility in Hwaseong next week. Below is the plan for your visit on Thursday, December 3.

10:00 Meeting with our R&D team
11:00 Tour of the sheet mask production line
12:30 Lunch
14:00 Quality control lab and Q&A

For hygiene reasons, all visitors will be asked to wear a gown, cap, and shoe covers in the production area. Photos are not allowed inside the clean room.

Our driver can pick you up at your hotel at 9:15. Please let us know your preferred pickup location by Monday.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee

Dear Ms. Weber,

We look forward to welcoming you to our facility next Wednesday. The visit will include a meeting with our R&D team and a tour of our cream production line. For hygiene reasons, please wear the gown we provide. Please let us know your preferred arrival time.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee
